en.answer: In that case, the destroyed Pendulum Monster is added face-up to the Extra Deck at the end of the Damage Step, but even in that case, the effect of <<7563>> can be activated.
en.question: Can the effect of <<7563>> be activated when it destroys a Pendulum Monster in battle?
